_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main each tick). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc) at the next IDLE hour (a scheduled tick wins its own hour); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-27 (energy+cot): generate the NEW alt-data feeds off-schedule — the forced FULL runs refresh-cot (Macro → Positioning) and refresh-energy (Macro → Energy; keyless prices populate now, the EIA weekly balance stays pending until EIA_API_KEY is set on the box + as a GH secret). Also harmlessly re-runs the valuation + real-economy feeds. Populates the two new tabs without waiting for the 23:00 UTC scheduled FULL.
